title: Run 154's 'packaged candidate ships a false Qt/PySide6 license claim' finding is FALSIFIED by the companion notice shipped in the same bundle

prior_finding_under_test.claimed_why_defect: dist/hpc-client-gui/_internal/QT_LGPL_SOURCE_OFFER.md asserts the release contains PySide6, Shiboken6 and Qt components, and refers to a THIRD_PARTY_VERSIONS.txt manifest that is not in the bundle.

companion_notice_lines.11-12: The V2 production runtime is wx (wxPython). Qt/PySide6 entries below are legacy-only (unadvertised `legacy-qt` extra, not shipped in the V2 ...)
companion_notice_lines.18: PySide6 (legacy-only) | LGPLv3 terms used by this project | Qt for Python bindings (legacy, not shipped in V2 production package)
companion_notice_lines.19: shiboken6 (legacy-only) | LGPLv3 terms used by this project | CPython bindings generator for Qt (legacy runtime support for PySide6)
companion_notice_lines.20: Qt libraries (legacy-only) | Applicable Qt LGPL terms | Qt libraries distributed through PySide6 (legacy, not shipped in V2 production package)
companion_notice_lines.48-50: Corresponding-source information for the legacy-only Qt and PySide6 components (source-checkout `legacy-qt` extra; not shipped in V2 production packages) is described in `QT_LGPL_SOURCE_OFFER.md`.

verdict: FALSIFIED as a release-integrity defect. The prior finding read QT_LGPL_SOURCE_OFFER.md in isolation and omitted the scoping statement that THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md states three times: the Qt/PySide6/shiboken6 entries are legacy-only, belong to the unadvertised `legacy-qt` extra, and are explicitly NOT shipped in the V2 production package. That scoping notice is itself shipped inside the same _internal directory as the notice it qualifies, so the licensing representation the release actually makes is accurate. The absence of THIRD_PARTY_VERSIONS.txt is likewise not a defect: build/windows/hpc-client-gui.spec:54 iterates the license-file names and includes only those present (THIRD_PARTY_VERSIONS.txt, SBOM.cdx.json and QT_LGPL_SOURCES.json are optional, repository-root-absent, and generated by the release scripts at release time).
residual_nitpick_not_raised_as_a_defect: QT_LGPL_SOURCE_OFFER.md on its own does not repeat the 'legacy-only / not shipped' qualifier. This is a wording improvement in a release-compliance document owned by the release/build surface, not a false claim, because the qualifier is co-located in the shipped bundle. It is recorded here for the owner and is deliberately not routed as a Wave-blocking defect.
consequence: This finding must NOT be used to block the W57 freeze decision. It is recorded so that the W57 evidence set does not carry an unmeasured, falsified blocker forward.
not_done: no license text, notice file, spec file or release script was modified
the prior artifact W57_RUN154_PKG_LICENSE_NOTICE_DEFECT.json is retained unchanged as history
